props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the scrolling region. Required: the region takes keyboard focus, and a focus stop with no name is announced as nothing.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which axes scroll. The other axis clips.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Any CSS length. Omit when a flex or grid parent already bounds the height.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Any CSS length, for horizontal scrolling inside an unbounded parent.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the edges that have more content beyond them.

props.name: fadeSize
props.description: Length of the fade, in pixels.

props.name: scrollbar
props.description: `thin` keeps a slim scrollbar; `hidden` removes it, for short lists inside a card where the fade already says there is more. The region still scrolls by wheel, touch and keyboard.
